title: Boolean column predicates must use == true(), not .is_(True), for MSSQL-compatible SQL
answers: label schema questions fail to load on MSSQL 2022
review queue question loading error on SQL Server tracking backend
MSSQL syntax error IS 1 in default label schema lookup
how to filter boolean column in SQLAlchemy for MSSQL compatibility
body:
Symptom: On MLflow with Microsoft SQL Server 2022 or older as the tracking backend, label-schema and review-queue question loading fails.
Root cause: mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:_ensure_default_label_schema filtered `SqlLabelSchema.is_default.is_(True)`, which compiles to `is_default IS 1`. MSSQL rejects `IS` with a numeric literal.
Fix pattern: write boolean column comparisons as equality, `SqlLabelSchema.is_default == sqlalchemy.true()`, which compiles to `= 1` on MSSQL and is valid on other backends.
Constraints: Applies to SQL predicates on boolean columns that run on MSSQL-supported stores. The PR only changed this one call site; other `.is_(True)` uses were not checked in the diff, so audit them before assuming they are safe.
Applies: SQLAlchemy tracking store filter predicates on boolean columns (for example SqlLabelSchema.is_default).
applies: Any SQLAlchemy boolean-column filter executed by the tracking store against an MSSQL backend.
says: Review queue questions fail to load when using Microsoft SQL Server tracking backend.
Opening the evaluation review screen shows a database syntax error on SQL Server.
Allow label schema and review questions to load properly on SQL Server 2022.
Default label schema lookups crash on databases that do not accept boolean IS syntax.
Make review queue question loading compatible with Microsoft SQL Server databases.
search: SQLAlchemy boolean column filters in the tracking store must use equality with sqlalchemy.true() rather than .is_(True) for MSSQL compatibility. In mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:_ensure_default_label_schema, filtering SqlLabelSchema.is_default.is_(True) compiles to IS 1, which Microsoft SQL Server rejects with a syntax error. Comparisons written as SqlLabelSchema.is_default == sqlalchemy.true() compile to = 1 on MSSQL; this guidance applies to tracking store boolean predicates on MSSQL, though only this single call site was updated.
